latestAttribution.cause: The new ranger lineup defeated main stage 5 in 13.2 seconds with all four allies surviving; the ranger also ranked second in damage, confirming the replacement test.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Equip the high-fit legendary helm before trying the newly unlocked content, then observe the displayed power gain.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the ordinary ring on the herb militia increased equipped power from 116 to 139, a smaller but still visible gain.

latestAttribution.cause: Equipping the mythic boots on the warrior changed equipped power from 0 to 116; merely owning the loot had not done that.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge the next main encounter and observe whether the equipped warrior remains the leading contributor while the team survives.

latestAttribution.cause: Replacing the herb militia in slot 3 with the newly unlocked ranger changed the active team and reduced equipped power from 181 to 158 because the herb militia's equipped ring left the active lineup.
latestAttribution.nextTest: Challenge main stage 5 and check whether the ranger places in the top two for team damage despite the lower displayed equipped power.
